findings.title: Self-issued source launch receipts and suffix-only ledger identity bypass the original reservation authority
reproduction: Execute the immutable worker validation prefix only; remove the unused scientific source-generation import and stop immediately before its scientific loop. Hard-disable NN entry points.

Create a temporary shadow ledger whose suffix is /lab/review6/budget-ledger.jsonl, with the original cycle/task and a zero-second reservation. Copy the public contract, change its output directory, and self-hash that contract and a new launch receipt.
Use the real current parent PID. The unchanged validation prefix accepts the forged receipt, shadow ledger and zero reservation and reaches the science entrance.
findings.impact: The raw scientific entry is not bound to the canonical original repo/ledger, fixed 600-second reservation, official receipt authority/path, active execution lease or canonical output. A direct invocation can evade the original budget/one-execution boundary. This does not show a defect in the completed official source result.
findings.requestedFix: Bind the task-specific canonical repo, ledger, fixed reservation, official launch authority, contract/output and active lease in the frozen worker guard as well as the public route. Verify the actual parent and exact lease before science. Historical source snapshots must remain immutable and may not be restarted.
findings.closureNeeded: New immutable entry/guard with pure sentinel red-to-green probes for shadow ledger, self-receipt, wrong output, absent/closed lease, wrong parent and fixed original reservation; no source rerun.

findings.title: Pool startup has no hard deadline and one worker failure leaves other workers alive
reproduction: Run temporary pure-JS workers with a 40ms pool deadline. A worker that never sends ready keeps the pool pending beyond 300ms.
Run two workers with an initialization error in one and a ready/waiting peer. The pool rejects, but the peer still has an active MessagePort after 300ms.
A probe-only watchdog exits the temporary child at 300ms to clean up; this is not component cleanup. A normal four-task positive control completes.
findings.impact: All-ready startup can hang beyond the budget. An error may return control to accounting while other workers remain alive. Dispatch-time deadline checks and per-branch monotonic checks do not cover initialization, stuck tasks or collective cleanup.
findings.requestedFix: Start a pool-wide hard timer before worker construction; cover ready and active phases. On timeout or any error terminate every worker and await all exits before resolving/rejecting and settling elapsed resources.
findings.closureNeeded: Pure-worker tests for never-ready, stuck active task, initialization/task/result-callback error and collective exit before rejection, plus unchanged positive dispatch.

findings.title: Ancestor directory symlinks pass snapshot verification and boot while resolving executable code outside the snapshot
reproduction: Build a synthetic native-marker snapshot; its entry imports the copied codec using a relative path. Normal boot returns frozen-copied-codec.

Replace snapshot/lab/review6 with an ancestor symlink to a temporary external directory containing byte-identical entry code. Provide an external relative codec with a different marker. Leave the original frozen codec bytes untouched.
Both verifyExecutableSnapshot and direct generated boot accept. Node realpaths the entry and imports the unlisted external codec.
findings.impact: Checking only the leaf lstat/hash does not close the executable tree. The declared hashes can remain valid while Node resolves relative imports outside the frozen workspace. The actual official source snapshot has no such realpath error.
findings.requestedFix: Require canonical snapshotRoot and canonical manifest/bootstrap/loader/entry; every declared ordinary file must have realpath exactly equal to its declared path and closed parents inside the root. Restrict aliases to the declared @gd links with closed parent directories and validated internal targets. Enforce the same rules in verifier and generated bootstrap.
findings.closureNeeded: Verify-side and direct-boot ancestor-symlink negatives, loader/entry/canonical-root/alias-parent cases, and a normal frozen snapshot positive. Do not edit or rerun the historical actual source snapshot.

findings.title: Inherited NODE_OPTIONS can execute an unlisted preload before the verified bootstrap
reproduction: Restore the temporary native-marker snapshot to its normal canonical tree; verify all declared hashes.
Reproduce the official child environment spread {...process.env,...} with NODE_OPTIONS set to --import of a temporary module outside that snapshot.
The external module writes a temporary marker before the bootstrap; normal frozen entry still succeeds. No AI module, source generation or model call is involved.
findings.impact: A valid frozen tree does not by itself constrain executable runtime inputs. Ambient Node preload/loader options may execute outside code before the manifest guard and do not become safe after the ancestor-path fix. The historical raw source logs contain no outside-snapshot loaded module; this is a new-entry guard defect, not evidence of past source contamination.
findings.requestedFix: Use a fixed/recorded child runtime environment and reject or clear ambient code-loading inputs, including NODE_OPTIONS/NODE_PATH and transpiler/binary/config redirection variables as applicable. Apply the policy to future official source and teacher child/worker launches. Preserve only explicit required runtime/environment values.
findings.closureNeeded: An external NODE_OPTIONS marker must not execute through the official bounded sentinel launcher; cover Node/transpiler redirection variables that the runtime actually honors and retain normal typed execution.

findings.requestedFix: Append a corrected readback/parser proof covering actual ESM and CJS load events, with the extra path/hash. Preserve the original readback and execution logs.
